description: Record a metric point your app "produced". Use this whenever the surrounding code emits a counter or gauge — e.g. on a page view, a successful checkout, or a measured latency. Counters are +N (default +1), values are gauges (e.g. 42.5 ms).

count.description: For COUNTER stats: how much to increment by. Omit (or set with `value`) for a gauge/measurement stat. If both `count` and `value` are omitted, this defaults to +1.

stat.description: Name of the metric to record (e.g. "page_views", "api.latency_ms", "checkout.success"). Allowed chars: letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, dots. Auto-created on first use.

timestamp.description: Optional Unix-seconds timestamp for back-dated datapoints. Omit for "now".

value.description: For VALUE/gauge stats: the measurement to record (e.g. 42.5 for "load time ms"). Omit for a counter increment.

name: track_metric
